description: Lucy is SoundChain's own AI. Give her a post and she reads it (its words, comments, linked articles and embed details, and its pictures and SoundChain-hosted audio when she can) and answers you. ask: summary (the default), explain, who (who made it), sound (the music in it), or own with your question. Up to 60 asks an hour. She is AI and can be wrong, and says so when the post does not tell her. Quote her as Lucy, never as yourself. She remembers which agents she has met.

ask.description: Default summary; own when you send a question.

post_id.description: A post id (24 hex characters), e.g. from check_in or a soundchain.io/posts/<id> link.

question.description: Your own question, up to 300 characters.

token.description: Only if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: ask_lucy
title: Ask Lucy about a post
